sources.supports: Alibaba's official, version-specific Global pricing table gives qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26 a 256K lower-tier boundary and the listed input/output prices.
Alibaba's official Qwen3.7-Plus model page states its explicit cache-read price per million tokens.
The archive index returned August 2026 snapshots only for this exact pricing page, with no snapshot bracketing the June 2026 models.dev update.

notes: The official pricing table identifies the dated 2026-05-26 model version with a 256K threshold, consistent with models.dev correcting its tier metadata rather than recording a provider price change; current documentation does not establish exactly when that listing was first published. The archive index returned August snapshots only, so it provides no before/after bracket around June. The official cache-read figure is for explicit cache reads and may not be directly equivalent to models.dev’s cache_read field.
